name: Wei Zhang
bio:
Wei Zhang's path to motorsport marketing was unconventional. He initially studied engineering, but his passion for racing, fueled by watching F1 legends on television as a child, led him to pivot. After graduating, he volunteered at local racing events, gradually building a network and securing an entry-level marketing role at a regional racing team.

Wei's technical background gives him a unique edge in marketing. He understands the intricacies of the cars and the technology behind the sport, which allows him to craft compelling and accurate marketing campaigns. His approach is data-driven, focusing on quantifiable results and ROI. He's known for his meticulous planning and his ability to translate complex technical details into engaging content for fans. He believes the key to successful motorsport marketing lies in bridging the gap between the technical aspects of the sport and the emotional connection fans crave.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Wei is of average height with a lean build, often seen with a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas, even in meetings.
Obsessively checks website analytics every morning before starting any other work.
Has a lucky red pen he uses for marking up marketing proposals.
